description: Flat metadata schema for individual records from CRISPR-Cas9 and mass-spectrometry-based high-throughput screening of protein interactions and causal signaling changes in human cancer cells.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this metadata record within the dataset.

source_protein_name.descr: Common or preferred name of the upstream protein/perturbed regulator (for example, an oncogene or regulatory protein).

source_gene_symbol.descr: HGNC gene symbol of the upstream protein/perturbed regulator.

source_protein_id.descr: Stable protein identifier for the upstream regulator, such as UniProt accession.

target_protein_name.descr: Common or preferred name of the downstream interacting protein or signaling molecule.

target_gene_symbol.descr: HGNC gene symbol of the downstream interacting protein or signaling molecule.

target_protein_id.descr: Stable protein identifier for the downstream target, such as UniProt accession.

interaction_type.descr: Type of biological relationship observed between source and target proteins, such as physical interaction, phosphorylation-linked association, pathway regulation, or complex membership.

causal_relationship_type.descr: Direction and nature of the causal effect observed, such as activates, inhibits, upregulates, downregulates, stabilizes, destabilizes, or no_effect.

causal_direction.descr: Direction of the inferred causal link, such as source_to_target, target_to_source, or bidirectional.

effect_size.descr: Quantitative magnitude of the observed change in interaction or signaling readout, expressed in the study's reported unit or normalized scale.

effect_direction.descr: Observed direction of change in the target measurement, such as increase, decrease, or unchanged.

effect_unit.descr: Unit or normalization basis for effect_size, such as fold_change, log2_fold_change, spectral_count_delta, or intensity_ratio.

p_value.descr: Statistical significance of the observed interaction or causal effect.

confidence_score.descr: Study-defined confidence or support score for the reported causal relationship, typically normalized to a bounded scale if available.

significance_flag.descr: True if the observation meets the study's threshold for statistical significance.

cell_line_name.descr: Name of the human cancer cell line used in the experiment, for example, A549, MCF7, or HeLa.

cell_line_accession.descr: Cell line repository accession or catalog identifier, if available.

cancer_type.descr: Cancer type or tissue of origin associated with the cell line, such as lung adenocarcinoma, breast carcinoma, or colorectal cancer.

species.descr: Organism of the experimental system, expected to be Homo sapiens for the cell model unless otherwise stated.

culture_medium.descr: Basal culture medium used for the cells, such as DMEM or RPMI-1640.

serum_percentage.descr: Percentage of serum in the culture medium during the experiment, expressed as percent (%).

treatment_name.descr: Name of any treatment, stimulus, inhibitor, or co-perturbation applied during the experiment.

treatment_concentration.descr: Concentration of treatment applied, in the reported unit such as nM, uM, or ng/mL.

treatment_duration_hours.descr: Duration of treatment exposure before readout, expressed in hours.

crisp_cas9_edited_gene.descr: Gene targeted for CRISPR-Cas9 knockout in the experiment.

edit_type.descr: Type of genome editing performed, typically knockout, knockout_pool, or variant_editing.

editing_validation_method.descr: Method used to validate successful editing, such as Sanger sequencing, amplicon sequencing, Western blot, or qPCR.

editing_efficiency.descr: Measured editing efficiency as a percentage, if reported.

mass_spectrometry_platform.descr: Mass spectrometry instrument or platform used, for example, Orbitrap Fusion or Q Exactive.

ms_acquisition_mode.descr: Mass spectrometry acquisition mode, such as DDA, DIA, PRM, or targeted MS.

sample_preparation_method.descr: Brief description of the protein extraction, digestion, enrichment, or immunoprecipitation workflow used before mass spectrometry.

quantification_method.descr: Method used to quantify protein abundance or interaction changes, such as label-free quantification, SILAC, TMT, or spectral counting.

technical_replicates.descr: Number of technical replicates used for this record's measurement.

biological_replicates.descr: Number of biological replicates used for this record's measurement.

observation_date.descr: Date on which the experiment or sample measurement was performed, in ISO 8601 format if available.

pathway_name.descr: Biological pathway associated with the observed signaling change, such as MAPK, PI3K-AKT, WNT, or apoptosis.

pathway_database.descr: Reference pathway resource used for annotation, such as KEGG, Reactome, or WikiPathways.

literature_doi.descr: Digital Object Identifier of the supporting publication, if available.

literature_pmid.descr: PubMed identifier of the supporting publication, if available.

literature_citation.descr: Human-readable literature citation supporting the observation.

evidence_code.descr: Controlled or study-defined evidence category describing how the relationship was supported, such as experimental, computational, or literature_curated.

notes.descr: Free-text notes for additional context, caveats, or experimental details not captured in other fields.
